reason: Liltloom is primarily a user-controlled writing-style memory and context layer that learns structured preferences, stores them for review, and applies bounded style context to AI writing when explicitly activated.

summaries.zh: 语织是一个中文优先的写作风格记忆插件，用于学习、管理并在需要时将用户的表达偏好提供给 AI 写作任务。
summaries.en: Liltloom is a Chinese-first writing-style memory plugin that learns and manages user preferences and supplies bounded style context to AI writing tasks when needed.

capabilities: Learns structured writing-style preferences from eligible user-authored text
Persists style rules, settings, activation state, and resource metadata
Optionally stores limited raw text excerpts with user controls and retention limits
Compiles and injects bounded style context into AI writing tasks when activated
Supports user-managed rule CRUD, import, export, and deletion
Can optionally call a separately configured small-model provider for style analysis
